title: Sing When You're Winning — Prevalence Tranche 02 Execution Receipt

scientific_result.interpretation: The count five has lost anomaly value. Generic five-photo same-athlete collages are common but usually span career/team contexts and therefore break at WORLD. Event-bound MVP/championship graphics can reproduce the full chain, including outside Fanatics merchandise. The remaining question is prevalence within an enumerated event-MVP visual source frame.

next_gate.name: ENUMERATED_EVENT_MVP_SOURCE_FRAME_40
next_gate.target: at least 40 unique single-event championship/MVP visual designs with duplicate-SKU clustering and image-level source count
next_gate.reason: Existence is settled; matched-genre frequency is not.
next_gate.blocked_claim: No rarity statement until the source frame is reproducibly enumerated or sampled and independently scored.

claim_ceiling: CI verifies internal consistency and preservation of counterexamples. It does not establish random sampling, population prevalence, statistical significance, causality, artist intent, supernatural signaling, retrocausality, or a JANUS-specific mechanism.
